policy: Child-to-parent message lookup; query and lexical novelty plus head/middle/tail; one parent scanned at a time; seeds reserved before additions.
cost: Linear scan of target-message text chunks; no query model for pure BM25. Candidate/output limits do not imply constant scan cost.
tie_policy: Source session/request/ordinal/offset/content hash, independent of common namespace prefix; vector SQL retains chunk id only after same content tie.
limits: No semantic guarantee for arbitrary interior facts with no distinguishing lexical features; not blind holdout, real model or official evaluation.
